simulation-boundaries.text: Simulation boundariesHKM1800-inspired visualization built from original procedural geometry. Not Cognibotics CAD or validated HKM1800 kinematics. Not validated robot dynamics or safety-certified. Not SICS AI proprietary software.Synthetic observations come from a deterministic observation model; camera images are not analyzed by computer vision. Workspace and collision preflight are conservative simulation logic. Motion timings are presentation timings, not measured robot performance.Camera controls and replay change only the view. A visible product movement does not prove business completion; verification requires the observation contract.
